detector.enforcement: tools/arkitscenes_repair_propose_gdino.py refuses a sidecar whose revision or sha disagrees once these fields are non-null, and refuses to treat a run as pinned while they are null.

frozen_from_run.note: Values observed by notebooks/repair_gdino_sam2_colab.ipynb cell [1] and frozen here before the result was scored.

detector.pin_procedure: The revision and weight sha256 are resolved and printed by notebooks/repair_gdino_sam2_colab.ipynb, then written into this file by the freeze commit before any result is claimed. This mirrors docs/c1_p1_multiview_proposals_protocol.md, which states the SAM weights SHA-256 is filled by the freeze commit after download and before any scene inference. Nothing here is invented ahead of the download.

frames.note: The identical 32-frame bundle the automatic-mask arm used. Reused unchanged so the mask source is the only variable.

segmenter.note: Same checkpoint as the automatic-mask arm. The variable under test is what prompts SAM, not which SAM.
segmenter.prompting: box prompts from the detector; multimask_output=false, one mask per accepted box

thresholds.source: published defaults of the Grounding DINO reference demo and the transformers post_process_grounded_object_detection docs
thresholds.sweep: none permitted; one operating point, one run per scene

vocabulary.prompt_formatting: Hyphens are rendered as spaces in the text prompt only ('trash-can' -> 'trash can'); the canonical hyphen form is what is stored and matched. This is prompt formatting, not a vocabulary change.
